hero.urgency: California Statute of Limitations — Act Now
hero.sub: Most accident victims walk away with a fraction of what they're owed. Answer 8 quick questions — find out what your case may be worth, 100% free.
hero.settlementsLabel: Past Case Results — DK Law Network

s1.label: Question 1 of 8
s1.question: What type of accident were you in?
s1.hint: California law protects injury victims — even minor injuries may qualify.

s2.label: Question 2 of 8
s2.question: When did your accident occur?
s2.hint: California's statute of limitations is generally 2 years from the date of injury.

s3.label: Question 3 of 8
s3.question: Who was primarily at fault for the accident?

s4.label: Question 4 of 8
s4.question: Were you injured in the accident?

s5.label: Question 5 of 8
s5.question: Did you receive medical treatment after the accident?
s5.hint: Medical records can be important when evaluating your claim.
options: Not Yet — My Accident Was Recent
No — It's Been Over 30 Days and I Haven't Seen a Doctor

s6.label: Question 6 of 8
s6.question: Are you currently represented by an attorney?
options: No, I Don't Have an Attorney

sCta.question: Accident victims who don't get legal help often walk away with far less than they deserve. Take advantage of a no-cost consultation with an injury advocate to find out exactly what you're owed.
options: Yes, Find Out What I'm Owed
No Thanks, I'll Take My Chances

s7.label: Question 7 of 8
s7.question: Almost Finished!
s7.hint: Tell us what happened so we can begin your free case evaluation.
s7.hintExample: (e.g. "Hit by a speeding driver at an intersection, injured my shoulder")
s7.placeholder: e.g. "Hit by a speeding driver at an intersection, injured my shoulder and neck..."
s7.errorMsg: ⚠ This field is required. Please describe your accident to continue.
s7.voiceTip: 💡 Quick tip: Tap the 🎤 on your keyboard to speak your answer!

s8.label: You're Almost Done!
